QuestInfo.name: [Post Season] Munchies Procurement
QuestInfo.0: Dehos of the Chryse Giants wants you to help him celebrate the 2012 post-season. What's a fantastic baseball game without some chicken, though? Dehos looks like a fella who could definitely eat more than few chickens... Discuss this little oversight with Dehos in town.
QuestInfo.1: Collect some delicious chickens for Dehos.\r\n#rTakenote that monsters more than 11 levels lower or 21 higher than you#k won't drop any.
QuestInfo.2: You brought some delicious chickens for Dehos. Nothing like munching on some chicken while watching a great game!

item.0: You still didn't find all of the #r#t3994662##k things? It shouldn't be too hard to find 30 of 'em. You can do it.
